summary: The agent correctly implements a regression stacking ensemble using text and tabular features but introduces several critical data science flaws. It fails to preserve the original test IDs for the submission file, which will result in an evaluation failure. Furthermore, the agent causes cross-validation leakage by applying global transformations before splitting, and creates a stacking target leak by reusing the exact same folds for models that consume out-of-fold features.
